issues.description: conandata.yml manually adds 6 mirror URL prefixes (gh-proxy.com, mirror.ghproxy.com, ghproxy.com, gitclone.com, moeyy.cn, kkgithub.com). Review memory R39 explicitly states: 'CI 会自动为 GitHub URL 添加镜像 fallback（gh-proxy/ghproxy/gitclone/moeyy/kkgithub），因此 conandata.yml 中只需写官方原始 URL，不要手动加镜像前缀。' The CI automatically handles mirror fallbacks.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the URL list with a single official URL string: url: "https://github.com/google/jsonnet/archive/refs/tags/v0.20.0.tar.gz". CI will automatically add mirror fallbacks at build time.

issues.description: Unused import: `import os` is imported but never used anywhere in the main conanfile.py. The os module is only used in test_package/conanfile.py (os.path.join), not in the recipe itself.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove `import os` from line 7 of conanfile.py.

issues.description: Build date inconsistency: version-level manifest has build_date "2026-05-28" (line 18) while software-level manifest (archives/j/jsonnet/manifest.yaml line 20) has build_date "2026-07-15". The dates should be consistent across manifests. notes.md also shows both dates: 编译日期 2026-05-28 and 编译结束 2026-07-15.
issues.fix_suggestion: Unify the build_date value in both manifests. Use the build completion date (2026-07-15) consistently, or clearly document that one is start and one is end.

issues.description: patch_description does not follow the expected format. Rule R12 specifies format "{serial} {description}" with space separators, e.g. "0001 build aux config.guess". Actual value is "Fix HMDFS symlink compatibility (ln -sf → rm -f && ln -s)" — missing the serial number prefix "0001".
issues.fix_suggestion: Use format like "0001 Makefile HMDFS symlink compatibility fix" to include the serial number prefix.

issues.description: package_type is set to "shared-library" which is a valid Conan 2.x value, but the project code style rule R2 suggests using "library" for libraries. The project convention uses the simplified value "library".
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using package_type = "library" to match the project convention, or update the rule to acknowledge Conan 2.x specific types like "shared-library".

issues.description: The requirements() method contains only `pass`, which is redundant since the base class already handles the no-requirements case.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the empty requirements() method entirely, or keep it with a comment like "# No external dependencies" for documentation clarity.

summary: Audit of jsonnet v0.20.0 Conan recipe (W4 Pre-PR Audit re-run). Verdict: PASS. No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. Key deception checks all passed: (1) test_package/test.c calls real jsonnet C API — jsonnet_make(), jsonnet_version(), jsonnet_evaluate_snippet(), jsonnet_realloc(), jsonnet_destroy() — with output verification, NOT a stub; (2) sha256 VERIFIED by downloading the actual tarball from github.com/google/jsonnet and computing hash — matches exactly (77bd269073807731f6b11ff8d7c03e9065aafb8e4d038935deb388325e52511b); (3) status is "built" in both manifests — honestly NOT marked as "published"; (4) no pre-compiled .so/.a/binary files in PR; (5) no #ifdef __OHOS__ empty stubs — adaptation done via real Makefile patch; (6) no hardcoded paths — uses self.source_folder, self.package_folder; (7) compiler obtained from Conan profile (self.conf.get) not os.environ — R33 compliant; (8) no settings.os == "Linux" misuse — no platform check needed for pure Makefile build; (9) version v0.20.0 matches upstream tag — R37 compliant; (10) patch file 0001-Makefile.patch exists on disk and contains legitimate HMDFS symlink fix (ln -sf → rm -f && ln -s). Four P2 (non-blocking style) issues: manually added mirror URLs in conandata.yml (should be auto-added by CI per R39), unused import os in conanfile.py, build_date inconsistency between manifests, and patch_description not following serial-number format (R12). Two P3 suggestions: package_type convention and redundant requirements() method. Recipe is ready for merge after addressing P2 items.
